result.topic_en: An archival cover note signed by Schlesinger (Göttingen, 29.9.1920), stating that both sheets are written in Weierstrass's own hand; only faint bleed-through of formulas from the reverse is visible.
result.transcription:
6 Bl.

beide Blätter sind eigenhändig[?] von Weierstraß geschrieben.

Göttingen 29.9.20

Schlesinger
